<pasted_content id="a7bb">
/plumb intent Keep plumb fit by itself. Make the merge into main the place where cleanliness is enforced, so I never clean up by hand again: at every landing, the documents and working files the landed records replace are removed and the log is compacted (the tidy job you already have recorded); validate must be at zero errors and the merge must leave no new stale link; the judge backlog is queued at each landing and at session start so nothing sits waiting; anything the status still counts after a landing goes to the debug workflow, not to me. Also fix the judge model's questions, which came back malformed three times today and left the verdict waiting. Build it on Opus or Sonnet in a workflow, in a worktree, and show me it working on one real landing: a status card with nothing stale, nothing waiting and no error.
</pasted_content id="a7bb">

 Also improve parallel intent loops work, especially based on the following observation: Worktrees and parallel work. Supported in principle, with rough edges. The loop's state and gates live in the main checkout's session folder, so a loop belongs to a session, not a worktree; I build in a worktree and run the gates from main, which works. Other branches' intents are visible, the same record changed on two branches raises an early conflict for you, and the merge is the single hold. The rough edges: a loop cannot be handed from one session to another, worktrees need the source path set by hand, and installs cannot run there. Confirm that staleness or other plumb related automation won't affect other ongoing parallel intent loop
